news_items.title: CONAB Brazil ka maize 139.572 MMT — USDA se 7 MMT ZYADA — Kal WASDE report aayegi, daam ke liye sabse badi khabar

news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** April 14, 2026 ko Brazil ki CONAB (Brazil ka apna krishi vibhag — USDA jaisa Brazil ka apna mantralaya) ne bataya ki Brazil mein maize ki paidawar (production) is saal 139.572 MMT (Million Metric Tonne — 13 crore 95 lakh tonne — bahut bada dher) hai. Jab USDA kal apni estimate badhata hai Brazil ke liye, toh global maize supply (duniya ka storage) zyada ho jaata hai — matlab duniya mein bahut zyada maal pada hai — India mein bhi darr hota hai ki zaroorat pe bahar se le lenge. Isse India ke mandi ke daam par neeche ka dabab aata hai. Brazil ki doosri fasal (safrinha — jo Brazil ki 80% maize hai) bhi almost complete ho rahi hai. USDA ne April WASDE mein 132.5 MMT bataya tha, kal May WASDE mein 135-138 MMT karne ki ummed hai — yeh bearish (daam girne wali) hogi.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Agar kal WASDE mein Brazil zyada dikhaya gaya toh India ke wholesale traders (bade khareedaar) sochenge 'zaroorat padi toh sasta bahar se mangaa lenge' — toh daam pe dabab. Purnea mandi mein May 11 ke baad ₹15-20 ki tez girawat iski wajah se bhi aa sakti hai. Duniya mein maal zyada = India mein daam saste.

news_items.title: AIDA ne E30 ki maang ki — Iran war mein ethanol urgency maximum — distillery wallon ko maize ki zaroorat BAHUT ZYADA
news_items.category: Ethanol Policy/AIDA — E30 Ki Maang Sarkar Se
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** March 22, 2026 ko AIDA (All India Distillers Association — poore India ki sharab — ethanol — banane wali factories ki sanstha) ne sarkar ko ek zaroori chithi likhi. Chithi mein kaha ki 'Iran ki ladaai mein tel bahut mehnga ho gaya hai — hum E20 (petrol mein 20% alcohol — jo 1 April se lagu hai) se bhi ZYADA de sakte hain, yani E25 ya E30 bhi de sakte hain. Isse India ka mehnga petrol ka daroga (import bill) kam hoga.' S&P Global (ek badi international jaankari sanstha) ne April 14 ka report diya ki Iran conflict ne India ka multi-faceted ethanol push tez kar diya hai — E20 se E30 ke saath-saath cooking ke liye bhi ethanol (LPG gas cylinder ki jagah) use karne ki baat chal rahi hai. India mein 2,000 crore liter ki capacity hai aur 380+ distilleries chal rahi hain.

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** E30 matlab petrol mein 30% alcohol (sharab) milana — E20 se 10% zyada. Agar E30 lagu hua toh har saal India ki distilleries ko BAHUT ZYADA maize chahiye. Aise samjho — E20 mein agar 1,200 crore liter ethanol chahiye tha, E30 mein 1,800 crore liter chahiye — yeh 50% zyada maize consume hogi. AIDA ka yeh kadam officially E30 ko 'under_review' (sarkari vichar mein) status pe le aaya hai. S&P Global jaisi badi company bhi keh rahi hai ki Iran war ke baad India E30 ki taraf bahut tezi se badh rahi hai.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** E30 agar lagu hua (jo ki Iran war ke chalte bahut zyada likely lag raha hai) toh maize ki permanent, badi demand fix ho jaayegi. Distillery waale zyada maize khareedenge — daam permanently ₹2,200+ tak aa sakte hain long term mein. Yeh bahut BULLISH (daam badhne wali) khabar hai kisan bhai ke liye.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: Short term mein becho jab daam acche hain, lekin E30 ki wajah se long-term storage karna bhi soch sakte ho.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: E30 ki demand dekhte hue maize ka ek accha part abhi ₹1,980 mein khareedna theek hai — daam aage aur badh sakte hain.

news_items.category: Sarkar Ka Tay Kiya Daam vs Mandi Ka Asli Daam
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** Purnea Gulabbagh APMC mandi mein aaj maize ₹1,980 per quintal (100 kilo) chal rahi hai. Sarkar ne MSP (Minimum Support Price — matlab sarkar ka tay kiya hua floor daam — matlab is se kam mein nahi bikna chahiye) ₹2,400 per quintal rakha hai is saal ke 2025-26 ke liye. Yeh gap (farq) ₹420 per quintal ka hai — 17.5% neeche. October 2025 se lekar aaj May 2026 tak — poore 7 mahine — market lagatar MSP ke NEECHE chal rahi hai. Sarkar khud nahi khareed rahi — koi sarkari procurement (sarkari kharidi) nahi ho rahi.

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** MSP matlab woh minimum daam jo sarkar kehti hai ki is se kam mein nahi bikni chahiye. Lekin aaj mandi mein ₹1,980 chal raha hai — ₹420 NEECHE MSP se! Matlab aise ki: sarkar ne bola ek bori (100 kilo) makka ₹2,400 mein bikni chahiye, lekin mandi mein sirf ₹1,980 mil raha hai — ₹420 ka direct loss! Agar aapke paas 10 quintal (1,000 kilo = 10 bori) maal hai toh ₹4,200 ka seedha ghata! Aise samjho: ₹100 ki cheez banaoge to sirf ₹82.50 milega. Yeh structural oversupply ka saaf sanket hai — bahut zyada maal hai, kam khareedaar hain.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Jab tak sarkar procurement nahi shuru karti ya koi badi policy announcement nahi aati tab tak mandi daam MSP ke neeche hi chahenge. Bihar mein +41.27% production wali situation mein toh aur bhi gap badhne ka khatra hai. Yeh ek warning hai ki ghate ka sauda ho sakta hai zyada intezaar karne par.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: Rakhna chhoddo, aaj ya kal becho. Jitna rakhoge utna aur ghata hoga jab arrivals aur peak hogi. Iran support se aaj accha daam hai.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: Structural oversupply dekh ke ruko — May 13-17 mein aur sasta mil sakta hai.

news_items.title: DDGS (American murgi-chaara) — India-US deal mein 5 lakh tonne ki limit, lekin FSSAI ka GM niyam abhi bhi rok raha hai
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** February 7, 2026 ko India-US ke beech ek trade deal hua jisme 5 lakh tonne (5,00,000 tonne — bahut bada dher) DDGS (yeh woh cheez hai jo maize se alcohol banaane ke baad bachi rehti hai — jise murgi, machhli aur janwaron ko khilaate hain) BINA TAX ke India aa sakti hai. Lekin FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India — India ka khaane ki safety-jaanch ki sanstha) ka ek niyam hai: yeh American chaara 'GM-mukht' (GM-free — genetically modified nahi) hona chahiye. America ka maize genetically modified hai (lab mein badla gaya beej) toh certificate nahi de sakte. Status aaj bhi 'pending' hai — abhi tak bahut kam DDGS aaya hai.

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** DDGS matlab 'Distillers Dried Grains with Solubles' — maize se sharab banaane ke baad jo bacha hua murgi-chaara hota hai. Agar yeh sasta American DDGS bade paimane mein India mein aaya, toh murgi-wale maize ki jagah yeh sasta chaara khareedenge — seedha maize ki demand KHATAM! Abhi GM barrier (GM ka niyam jo rok raha hai) wahi hai — toh abhi tak bada asar nahi pada. Par yeh latent risk (chhupa hua khatra) hai.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Abhi koi immediate asar nahi — FSSAI ka niyam rok raha hai. Lekin nazar rakhna chahiye. Agar kabhi FSSAI ne clearance di toh murgi-wale maize nahi khareedenge — badi demand loss hogi. Abhi ke liye is par zyada fikar mat karo.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: Abhi is news ka zyada asar nahi — maal becho, par FSSAI news par nazar rakhna.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: Agar FSSAI clearance ki khabar aaye toh jaldi khareed lo us se pehle hi — daam girenge.

news_items.title: IMD Purnea: Aaj saaf mausam, koi chetavni nahi — 10 May ko Bijli aur Andhi ka alert — aaj becho maal geela hone se pehle
news_items.category: IMD Mausam / Rabi Fasal Ki Katai
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** IMD (India Meteorological Department — India ka sarkari mausam vibhag) ke Purnea ke liye aaj (8 May) ke data ke mutabik:
- Minimum temperature: 22°C, Maximum: 32°C
- Forecast: Partly cloudy sky (thoda badal wala aasmaan)
- Chetavni: NO WARNING aaj ke liye
- **10 May ke liye alag chetavni:** Thunderstorm + Bijli + 40-50 km/h ki tez hawa ka Orange level alert

AccuWeather Katihar bhi aaj ek tarah ka afternoon t-storm (dopahar ka toofan) dikhaa raha hai — par iska IMD se zyada confidence nahi.

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** Mausam saaf hona matlab — khet mein khadi ya kat chuki makka jaldi SOOKH sakti hai (makka geeli ho to mandi mein nahi bik sakti — daam kam milta hai). Aaj maal laana mandi mein aasaan hai. Lekin 10 May ko toofan aane se maal geela ho sakta hai — is din mandi mein laana mushkil hoga. Agar geela maal aaega toh dalal aur khareedaar zyada discount maangenge. Aise samjho — agar dum wali makka laao toh daam accha milta hai, agar geeli makka laao toh cutting hoti hai.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Aaj saaf mausam = mandi mein maal laane ke liye best day. 10 May se pehle jitna bech sako becho. Thunderstorm se aane wale 2-3 dino mein arrivals thodi dheemi hogi — jo short-term mein daam ko thoda support dega.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: Aaj aur 9 May (Saturday) — dono din mausam accha hai. Maal le jaao — 10 May ke toofan se pehle becho.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: 10 May ke baad arrivals dheemi hongi toh daam thoda toot sakta hai — tab khareedna samajhdaari.

video_news.title: Purnea Gulabbagh Mandi — 5 May 2026 ka live makka rate: ₹2,050 per quintal — purneakhabar channel
video_news.published_display: 5 May 2026 — Purnea Gulabbagh ka live update
video_news.description: Yeh ek bahut important live video/reel hai purneakhabar channel ka jo seedha Gulabbagh APMC mandi se report karta hai. 5 May ko unhone confirm kiya ki Purnea Gulabbagh mandi mein makka ka daam ₹2,050 per quintal chal raha tha — woh bhi achhi quality wale ke liye. Yeh bahut badi khabar hai kisan bhai ke liye kyunki bahut log ₹1,900 wala IndiaMART ka rate dekhte hain jo sirf ek seller ka rate hota hai. Asli mandi (APMC sarkari bazaar) mein daam kaafi zyada accha hai. Kisan bhai: aaj bhi ₹1,980-2,050 milne ki sambhavna hai Gulabbagh mandi mein — vahan jaao, compare karo.

video_news.title: Maize prices today, May 6, 2026 — Bihar mandi mein teza aayi, Iran war ka bhi asar
video_news.description: Yeh video 6 May 2026 ka Bihar mandi ka makka (maize) bhav dikha raha hai. Is video se pata chalta hai ki Bihar mandis mein makka ke daam tezi pakad rahe hain — Iran ki ladaai ki wajah se ethanol (maize se bana petrol mein milane wala paani) ki zaroorat bahut badh gayi hai. Kisan bhai ke liye: yeh video confirm karta hai ki mandi mein daam ₹1,900-2,000 ke beech chal rahe hain. Aaj ka NCDEX ₹2,040 ka premium bhi is trend ko support kar raha hai. Agar tel mehnga raha (jo Hormuz ki ladaai ki wajah se lag raha hai) toh yeh trend aur badhega.

video_news.title: 3 May 2026 | मक्का भाव 1950–2050 | Purnia Gulabbagh Mandi Maize Rate Today
video_news.description: Yeh short video 3 May 2026 ka Purnea ke Gulabbagh mandi ka daam dikha raha hai — ₹1,950 se ₹2,050 per quintal ke beech. Yeh ground reality hai — IndiaMART wala ₹1,900 nahi. Achhi quality maize (sukhi, 12% nami se kam) ke liye ₹1,950-2,050 milta hai asli APMC sarkari bazaar mein. Kisan bhai ke liye: yeh ek important jaankari hai ki aapki achhi quality ki fasal ke liye zyada daam mila. Aaj (8 May) bhi ₹1,980-2,050 milne ki sambhavna hai. Gulabbagh mandi mein jaao aur achi quality maal becho.

video_news.title: Makka ka daam aur badhega? Kab milega ₹2,400 — India mein maize ka future kya hai
video_news.description: Yeh video India mein maize ke daam ke future (aage ka anumaan) ke baare mein hai — kab ₹2,400 MSP (sarkar ka tay kiya minimum daam) milega? Iran ki ladaai, E20 niyam aur NCDEX ke signals ko dekhte hue expert log bata rahe hain ki ₹2,000-2,100 tak jaana possible hai agle 3-4 hafte mein agar Iran ka haal nahi sudhra. Kisan bhai ke liye: aaj ₹1,980 milta hai — agar quality achi hai aur rakhne ki jagah free hai toh thoda aur ruko, ₹2,000+ ho sakta hai. Lekin May 15 ke baad peak arrivals khatam hone lagegi — tab price direction badal sakta hai.

video_news.title: Maize prices have risen again — what's driving the rally in Bihar corn market
video_news.description: Yeh video Bihar mandi mein maize ke daam ki tezi ko samjha raha hai — kya kar raha hai daam ko UPAR? Three reasons: (1) Iran war mein tel bahut mehnga hua hai — ethanol (maize se banna wali) ki zaroorat bahut zyada; (2) NCDEX mein Strong Buy signal aa raha hai; (3) Distillery wale zyada khareed rahe hain. Kisan bhai ke liye: yeh rally (daam badhna) asli hai aur aaj bhi jaari hai kyunki raat ko Hormuz mein firing hui. Iran ki situation dhyan se dekho — agar shanti aayi toh daam girenge, agar tezi aayi toh badhenge.

video_news.title: BREAKING: Iran-America Hormuz mein firing — Brent crude ek raat mein $102.70 — maize ke daam par kya asar
video_news.description: OilPrice.com (ek badi tel ki news website) ne raat bhar ki khabar di — America ke teen jahazon par Iran ne hamla kiya Hormuz mein, America ne wapas hamlaa kiya. Brent crude $98 se ₹102.70 par pahuncha — ek hi raat mein 2.64% ki tezi. Project Freedom (America ki Hormuz se jahazon ko guide karne ki koshish) bhi Saudi Arabia ne rok di. Kisan bhai ke liye: yeh BAHUT important khabar hai — tel mehnga = ethanol zaroorat zyada = maize ki demand zyada = daam pe support. Aaj subah se mandi mein distillery wale zyada khareedenge. Is news ki wajah se aaj ka Purnea mandi ka daam ₹1,980 tak gaya — aur NCDEX bhi ₹2,040 pe mazboot hai.

video_news.title: AIDA (sharab banane walon ki sanstha) ne maang ki E30 ki — Iran war ke baad ethanol ki zaroorat aur badhegi
video_news.published_display: 22 March 2026 — AIDA ki sarkar ko chithi
video_news.description: Outlook Business (badi English business patrika) ne khabar di ki AIDA (All India Distillers Association — poore India ki sharab/ethanol banane wali factories ki sanstha) ne sarkar ke Highway Minister Gadkari ko chithi likhi. Chithi mein kaha: 'Iran ki ladaai mein tel bahut mehnga — hum petrol mein 20% se ZYADA ethanol de sakte hain. E30 yani 30% ethanol lo.' Yeh bahut important khabar hai kisan bhai ke liye kyunki agar E30 lagu hua toh har saal AUR ZYADA maize lagi distilleries ko — daam ₹2,200-2,400 tak aa sakta hai. Abhi E30 'under review' (sarkari vichar mein) hai. Long-term ke liye bahut acchi khabar hai.

video_news.title: CONAB Brazil maize 139.572 MMT — USDA se 7 MMT zyada — kal WASDE ka asar kya hoga India mandi par
video_news.description: Brownfield Ag News (America ka bada kheti ki khabar ka website) ne bataya ki Brazil ki CONAB sanstha ka maize production estimate 139.572 MMT hai — America ka USDA ₹132.5 MMT kehta hai. Yeh 7 MMT ka bada farq hai. Kal (9 May, Saturday) USDA ki WASDE report aayegi jisme USDA apna estimate badhane wala hai — Brazil ke kaafi zyada maal ki khabar se global supply (duniya ka maize storage) zyada dikhega. Kisan bhai ke liye: yeh bearish khabar hai — duniya mein zyada maal matlab India ke khareedaar sochenge 'zaroorat pade toh bahar se bhi mangaa sakte hain.' Kal WASDE ke baad anumaan saaf ho jaayega — agar USDA Brazil ko bahut zyada dikhaya toh Monday ko mandi mein dabab aa sakta hai.

video_news.title: Bihar maize mandi bhav aaj — CommodityOnline se Bihar ka average daam aur range
video_news.description: CommodityOnline website Bihar mandi ka data dikhaata hai. Website par Bihar average ₹1,936/quintal likha hai lekin yeh December 2023 ka purana APMC data hai — site ka actual APMC data update bahut late aata hai. Range ₹1,861 se ₹2,100 per quintal dikhaya gaya hai. Mandis covered hain: Bhawanipur (Purnea district), Kishanganj, Gulabbagh, Kaswa. Kisan bhai ke liye: yeh website check karte rehna chahiye, lekin ground reality ke liye purneakhabar Instagram ya seedha mandi mein jaana zyada sahi hai. CommodityOnline ka range ₹1,861-₹2,100 sahi reflect karta hai ki market bahut broad hai quality ke hisaab se.

video_news.title: CBOT July 2026 corn 467¢/bu — Buy Signal Strong — Managed Money 380,569 net long — US exports 1.362 MMT this week
video_news.description: Barchart (America ki badi financial website) par CBOT (America ka bada maize bazaar — jahan duniya ka daam tay hota hai) mein maize ka July 2026 contract 467.25 cents per bushel (roughly ₹124 per kilo) par tha kal. 'Buy Signal Strong' — matlab bade investors soch rahe hain daam badhega. Managed Money (bade foreign investors) ne 380,569 long positions liye hain — bahut bullish sanket. Weekly corn exports 1.362 MMT rahi — thoda kam tha last week se. Iran ki ladaai ne crude oil ek din ₹2.52 gain karaya. Kisan bhai ke liye: America ka bazaar bhi bullish hai — yeh indirect support deta hai India ke NCDEX ko bhi.

video_news.title: IMD Purnea mausam forecast — 8 May saaf, 10 May Thunderstorm + bijli + 40-50 kmph hawa ka alert
video_news.description: IMD (India Meteorological Department — India ka sarkari mausam vibhag) ke Purnea ke liye aaj ka official forecast: Min temp 22°C, Max 32°C, Partly cloudy, NO WARNING aaj ke liye. Lekin 10 May ke liye Thunderstorm + Bijli + gusty winds (40-50 km/h hawa) ka alert hai. Kisan bhai ke liye: aaj mausam saaf hai — maal mandi le jaao. Kal Saturday bhi theek hai. 10 May ko toofan aane wala hai — us din mandi nahi jaana chahiye. Geela maal agar mandi aaya toh ₹50-100 ki cutting kaata jaata hai priti quintal. Aaj aur kal hi maal bech do.

video_news.title: Brent crude oil war-time high $114 se $98 tak gira ceasefire ki umeed par — lekin raat ko phir $102 hua
video_news.published_display: April 30, 2026 — Brent crude ki roller coaster
video_news.description: CNBC (America ka bada news channel) ne bataya ki 29-30 April ko Brent crude $126 (2026 ka highest — sabse mehnga) se $114 tak gira ek hi din mein. Reason: America ka CENTCOM ne Iran par strike ke plans Trump ko dikhaye — Trump ne Iran ko dhamki di — lekin phir ceasefire ki baat chali. Kisan bhai ke liye: yeh dikhata hai ki tel ka daam sirf ek khabar se $20 upar-neeche ho sakta hai. Kal raat Iran-America ne Hormuz mein firing ki — phir tel $102.70 ho gaya. Jab tel zyada hota hai maize ki demand badhti hai (ethanol ke liye). Yeh volatility (daam ka oopar-neeche karna) Iran ki wajah se hai — ek din notice pe market badal sakta hai.

market_sentiment.text: Aaj ka bazaar ka mood 'mildly bullish' (thoda accha) hai — aise samjho jaise mela mein ek haath mein laddoo aur doosre haath mein kante ke kankar hain. Ek taraf NCDEX ₹2,040 par Strong Buy ka signal hai, Iran ki ladaai phir se tezi pakad rahi hai aur Brent tel ₹102.70 par hai — yeh sab BULLISH (daam badhne wali) baten hain. Doosri taraf Bihar mandi mein +41.27% zyada rabi fasal aa rahi hai aur kal WASDE ka risk hai — yeh BEARISH (daam girne wali) baten hain. Do takatwar forces ek dusre se lad rahi hain. Confidence 62% hai — matlab 100 mein se 62 baar yeh bullish direction sahi niklegaa.
market_sentiment.summary: Aaj 8 May 2026 ko Purnea Gulabbagh mandi ka asli daam ₹1,980 per quintal (100 kilo) hai — pichli report ke ₹1,900 IndiaMART estimate se ₹80 upar. Asli Gulabbagh APMC mein achhi quality maize ke liye ₹2,000-₹2,050 bhi mil raha hai. Teen BULLISH khabaren hain ek saath: (1) Raat ko Iran-America ke beech Hormuz mein seedha hamla hua — ceasefire toot gaya — Brent tel ₹102.70 — ethanol ki zaroorat maximum; (2) NCDEX ₹2,040 par Strong Buy signal — Purnea se ₹60 upar — bade traders daam badhne ki bet laga rahe hain; (3) AIDA ne E30 ki maang ki hai — Iran war ki wajah se ethanol push bahut tez. Lekin teen BEARISH baten bhi hain: Bihar mein +41.27% zyada rabi fasal peak mein aa rahi hai, kal WASDE mein Brazil 7 MMT zyada dikhne wali hai, aur MSP se ₹420 neeche chal rahi hai mandi. Kisan bhai: agar achi quality maal hai toh aaj ₹2,000-2,050 milta hai Gulabbagh mein — aaj becho ya May 12-14 ka intezaar karo, lekin May 15 ke baad ziyadati arrivals chhoot jaayegi aur daam thoda girne lage.

predictions_10_day.trend_text: Din 1 (8 May, Shukravar) mein daam ₹1,980 chal raha hai — yeh pichle IndiaMART estimate ₹1,900 se ₹80 upar hai kyunki Gulabbagh APMC ka asli daam hamesha se ₹1,960-2,050 tha — aur aaj raat ko Iran-America Hormuz mein firing se Brent tel ₹102.70 hua hai toh ethanol ka pressure bahut zyada hai. Kisan bhai: aaj ka din best selling day hai — achhi quality ₹2,000-2,050 mein becho.

Din 2 (9 May, Shanivaar — Saturday) mein daam thoda sa ₹5 upar aakar ₹1,985 par rahega. Kyunki Saturday ko mandi mein kaam thoda kam hota hai — lekin kal WASDE report aayegi (America ki badi global maize report) jo bazaar ke liye bahut important hai. Iran war premium bhi chal raha hai. Shanivaar ko 50% activity hoti hai. Kisan bhai: aaj bhi maal leke jaao — ₹1,985 milega.

Din 3 (10 May, Ravivaar — Sunday) ko mandi BAND rehti hai — koi kharidi-biki nahi hoti. Daam wahi ₹1,985 rahega. Iske alawa IMD ne aaj Thunderstorm + Bijli + 40-50 kmph hawa ka alert diya hai — isliye khet mein kaam karna mushkil hoga. Kisan bhai: aaj ghar par aaram karo par Monday ke liye plan banao.

Din 4 (11 May, Somwaar — Monday) mein daam ₹15 gira ₹1,970 par aa jaayega. Kyunki kal (Saturday 9 May) ki WASDE report ka analysis bazaar mein aa jaayega — agar USDA ne Brazil ko zyada bataya toh global bearish signal aayega. Saath mein Bihar mandi mein nayi rabi fasal ki arrivals bhi peak par hain. Bilkul waise jaise mele mein ek saath bahut saare dukandaar ek hi cheez bechne lage — daam toot jaata hai. Kisan bhai: agar pehle nahi becha toh Monday ko zaroor becho.

Din 5 (12 May, Mangalwaar) mein daam ₹12 aur gira ₹1,958 par. Peak arrivals (sabse zyada maal mandi mein aana) ka pura dabab ab aa gaya hai — Bihar ki mandis mein rozana zyada se zyada nayi rabi makka aa rahi hai. WASDE ke baad bhi market thoda bearish (daam girne wali soch) mein hai. Kisan bhai: jo bachi thi maal — aaj ya kal bech do zaroor.

Din 6 (13 May, Budhwar) mein daam ₹10 aur gira ₹1,948 par. Peak arrivals continue hain — mandi mein bahut saara maal pada hai aur khareedaar utne nahi. Iran war premium thoda support de raha hai warna aur tez girawat hoti. Kisan bhai: agar rakhte raho toh abhi bhi ₹1,948 se neeche aur jayega — jaldi karo.

Din 7 (14 May, Guruwar) mein daam ₹8 aur gira ₹1,940 par. Aaj ek important event bhi hai: NCDEX ka May 2026 contract (P$K26) expire ho jaayega aaj — June contract ab front month banega. Yeh transition thodi uncertainty laata hai. Arrivals abhi bhi peak par hain — daam ki kamzori jaari hai. Kisan bhai: is din ke baad tapering shuru honge — par daam girne ki speed thodi dheemi hogi.

Din 8 (15 May, Shukravar) mein daam ₹5 gira ₹1,935 par. Aaj se 'rabi tapering' shuru hoti hai — matlab rabi fasal ki peak arrivals ab dheemi padne lagi hain. Girawat ki speed kam hone lagi hai — ₹5 per din ya thoda kam. Iran premium abhi bhi ₹1,930-1,940 ke neeche jaane se rok raha hai. Kisan bhai: agar abhi bhi maal pada hai toh zyada wait mat karo — aage June mein kharif season ki taraf jaana hoga.

Din 9 (16 May, Shanivaar — Saturday) mein daam ₹4 gira ₹1,931 par. Saturday ka normal half-activity wala din. Tapering phase chal raha hai — girawat dheemi hai ab. Kisan bhai: agar achi quality maal abhi bhi pada hai toh Shanivaar ko bhi mandi jaao — ₹1,931 milega.

Din 10 (17 May, Ravivaar — Sunday) ko mandi BAND — koi kharidi-biki nahi. Daam wahi ₹1,931 par. 10-din mein daam ₹1,980 se ₹1,931 tak aaya — ₹49 ki girawat. Kisan bhai ke liye: agar aaj tak achi quality maal rakhte aa rahe ho aur Iran war aur tez hua toh ₹1,940-1,950 pe support bana rahega. Lekin agar Iran deal hua ya WASDE bahut bearish raha toh ₹1,900 bhi dekh sakte ho. Apna risk judge karo.

buyers.action_text: THODI THODI KHARIDO — 30% aaj ₹1,980 par, baaki 70% May 11-14 ke beech jab arrivals peak pe hongi aur ₹1,940-1,960 milega

buyers.advice: Jo log makka KHAREEDNA chahte hain — murgi-wale (poultry wale), factory-wale (starch aur alcohol banane wale): Abhi saari kharidi ek dam mat karo. Aaj ka ₹1,980 ka daam NCDEX ke ₹2,040 premium ki wajah se zyada hai — Iran war ke premium ne thoda upar kar diya hai. Aise samjho jaise aap mela shuru hone se thoda pehle saman khareedne gaye — poori kharidi mat karo kyunki 3-4 din baad aur sasta milega jab bahut zyada maal aaega. Sabse accha plan yeh hai: (1) 30% zaroori stock aaj ₹1,980 mein khareed lo — safety ke liye; (2) Kal Saturday WASDE aayegi — agar Brazil zyada dikhaya toh Monday ₹1,960-1,970 mein 40% khareed lo; (3) May 13-15 ke beech jab peak arrivals ka asar dikhega tab baaki 30% ₹1,935-1,950 mein khareed lo. sellers.action_text: AAJE HI BECHO — Gulabbagh mandi mein aaj ₹1,980-2,050 milta hai, May 11 se daam ₹1,970 neeche jayega — Iran premium ab tak ka sabse accha mauka hai

sellers.advice: Jo log makka BECHNA chahte hain — kisan bhai: Gulabbagh APMC (Purnea ka sarkari mandi) mein aaj subah jaao. Achhi quality (sukhi maize, 12% se kam nami) ke liye ₹2,000-₹2,050 milega, medium quality ke liye ₹1,900-₹1,980 milega. Yeh Iran war ka premium hai — ek baar agar WASDE bearish aayi ya Iran ceasefire hua toh daam ₹1,920 tak gir sakta hai. Aise samjho: jaise aam ke mausam ke shuruaat mein becho — baad mein sab ek saath aam laayenge toh daam toot jaata hai. Sabse sahi plan: (1) Aaj 70-80% maal becho — ₹1,980-2,050 ka zyada se zyada fayda uthao; (2) Agar quality bahut achi hai (sukha, koi mold nahi) aur storage free hai toh 20-30% May 12-14 ke liye rakho — Iran ki koi badi news aaye toh aur zyada mil sakta hai. (3) May 15 ke baad ek bhi quintal mat rakho — peak arrivals khatam hone lagegi, daam ₹1,931 ya ussse bhi neeche aa sakta hai. Risk hai ki agar Hormuz deal hua aur tel gira toh ethanol ki zaroorat ghati — daam ₹1,900 tak bhi ja sakta hai. Aaj ki opportunity mat chhodna.
sellers.alternative: Agar aapki maize ki quality bahut acchi hai (moisture — nami — 12% se kam, koi mold nahi, achi rangat, uniform size) aur storage BILKUL free hai — toh May 12-14 tak 25-30% maal rakh sakte ho. Kyunki NCDEX ₹2,040 pe hai aur Iran war chalu hai — koi bada bullish news aa sakta hai ₹2,100+ bhi possible hai. Lekin 75% aaj hi becho. May 15 ke baad zero rakhna — tapering shuru ho jaayegi aur June mein kharif ke naye seasonal pattern mein jaayega.

bearish: Bihar mandi mein rabi (sardi ki) maize ki peak arrivals (sabse zyada maal ek saath mandi mein aana) chal rahi hai aur pichle saal se 41.27% ZYADA fasal aayi hai is baar. Aise samjho: ek hi mela mein sab ek saath ek hi cheez bechne aa gaye — khareedaar utne nahi jitna maal hai — toh daam toot jaata hai. April 5 se May 15 tak sabse zyada maal aata hai. Yeh sabse bada BEARISH (daam girne wala) factor hai — zyada maal matlab kam daam. Haan, Iran support aur NCDEX premium ek had tak rok rahe hain — par arrivals ka dabab bahut bada hai.

CONAB (Brazil ka Krishi Mantralaya) ne April 14 ko bataya ki Brazil mein maize 139.572 MMT (13 crore 95 lakh tonne) hai — America ke USDA ke 132.5 MMT anumaan se 7 MMT ZYADA. Kal Saturday 9 May ko WASDE (America ki mahatvapurna global report — jisme poori duniya ki fasal ka anumaan hota hai) aayegi. Agar USDA apna estimate Brazil ke liye badhata hai toh global supply (duniya ka maal stock) zyada dikhega — India mein bhi signal milega ki 'zaroorat pade toh bahar se sasta mangaa lenge.' Isse domestic daam par dabab aayega. BEARISH risk hai kal ke WASDE se.

Purnea mandi mein aaj maize ₹1,980 chal raha hai. Sarkar ne MSP (Minimum Support Price — matlab sarkar ka tay kiya hua floor daam jis se kam mein nahi bikna chahiye) ₹2,400 per quintal rakha hai. Matlab ₹420 per quintal ka seedha nuksan! October 2025 se lekar aaj May 2026 tak — poore 7 mahine — market lagatar MSP ke NEECHE chal rahi hai. Sarkar khud nahi khareed rahi — koi sarkari procurement nahi ho rahi. Yeh structural oversupply (bahut zyada maal, kam khareedaar) ka saaf sanket hai. Aise samjho: bazaar mein itna maal pada hai ki sarkar bhi nahi khareedna chahti. BEARISH signal.

America aur India ke beech February 2026 mein ek trade deal hua jisme 5 lakh tonne American DDGS (yeh woh chaara hai jo maize se alcohol banaane ke baad baki rehta hai — jise murgi, machhli ko khilaate hain) BINA TAX ke India aa sakta hai. Abhi FSSAI (khaane ki safety sanstha) ka GM-free certificate wala niyam rok raha hai — kyunki America ka maize genetically modified hai. Agar FSSAI kabhi clearance de di toh murgi-wale maize ki jagah yeh sasta American chaara khareedenge — 3-5 MMT maize ki demand KHATAM ho sakti hai. Abhi latent (chhupa hua) BEARISH risk hai — FSSAI news par nazar rakhna.
bullish: Raat ko Iran aur America ke beech Strait of Hormuz (samandar ki woh zaroori gali jis se duniya ka 20% tel guzarta tha) mein seedha hamla hua — America ke jahazon par Iran ne fire kiya, America ne wapas hamlaa kiya. Brent Crude (woh kach-tel jisse petrol banta hai) ek hi raat mein $102.70 par pahunch gaya — Iran war ka premium maximum pe hai. Jab tel $100 se upar hota hai toh sarkar ko BAHUT JALDI maize se ethanol banana padta hai — E20 ka niyam toh 1 April se lagu hai hi. AIDA (distillery sanstha) ne already E30 maang liya hai. Yeh direct maize demand ka bahut bada engine hai. Goldman Sachs ne ₹140-150 barrel ka khatra bataya agar Hormuz bandh raha. BAHUT BULLISH.

NCDEX (Delhi ka bada sarkari fasal-bazaar) mein maize ka May 2026 contract ₹2,040 chal raha hai — Purnea mandi ke ₹1,980 se ₹60 UPAR. 'Strong Buy' signal aa raha hai — RSI 70 par hai (bullish zone), ADX 33 hai (strong trend indicator). Barchart ne bhi 'Buy Signal Strong' confirm kiya. Managed Money (bade international investors) bhi CBOT mein 380,569 net long positions liye hain. Yeh sab signal dete hain ki bade traders daam badhne ki bet laga rahe hain. Aise samjho: hamare gaon ke mukhia (NCDEX) ne kaha hai ki daam badhega — toh mandi mein bhi daam ₹2,040 ke taraf jayega. BULLISH.

AIDA (All India Distillers Association — poore India ki sharab-ethanol banane wali factories ki sanstha) ne sarkar se March 2026 mein officially maang ki E30 (petrol mein 30% ethanol) lao — E20 (20%) se aur zyada. S&P Global ne April 14 ko confirm kiya ki Iran war ne India ki multi-faceted ethanol push tez kar di hai — E30 ke saath cooking ke liye ethanol (LPG ki jagah) use karne ki baat bhi chal rahi hai. India mein 380+ distilleries chal rahi hain jo 2,000 crore liter capacity rakhti hain. Agar E30 lagu hua — jo Iran war ke chalte bahut zyada likely hai — toh makka ki permanent zyada demand fix ho jaayegi. Pichle 7 mahine mein AIDA ki ₹1.18 lakh crore ka ethanol procurement farmers ke paas pahuncha hai. BULLISH long term.

India ki murgi-palan (poultry) industry har saal 8% badhti ja rahi hai — ₹23.52 MMT (2 crore 35 lakh tonne) makka ki zaroorat hai sirf murgi khilaane ke liye har saal. DDGS (American sasta murgi-chaara) abhi bhi FSSAI ke niyam ki wajah se nahi aa raha — GM barrier tuta nahi. Isliye murgi-wale makka hi khareedte hain. Yeh ek bada permanent khareedaar hai jo har saal zyada makka khareedta jaata hai. Aise samjho: 8% zyada murgiyan = 8% zyada makka chahiye har saal. BULLISH base.
neutral: India ka rupaya (rupee) aaj ₹94.40 per dollar ke aas paas chal raha hai (May 7 ka XE data). Kal ke ceasefire optimism se rupaya ₹93.95 tak gaya tha (May 5 data), ab wapas thoda kamzor hua. Jab rupee kamzor hota hai toh bahar se maal mangaana (import) MEHNGA ho jaata hai — toh videsh se sasta maize mangaana mushkil ho jaata hai. Isse domestic maize thoda zyada competitive ho jaata hai. Yeh ek chhoti si supportive cheez hai kisan ke liye — na bahut buri, na bahut acchi. NEUTRAL.

Kal Saturday 9 May ko USDA ki WASDE report aayegi — yeh pehli WASDE hai jo 2026-27 naye season ka anumaan degi. Isme Brazil, Argentina, India ka naya crop projection aayega. Agar Brazil zyada dikhaya gaya — BEARISH. Agar Iran demand zyada dikhaya — BULLISH. Dono possibilities hain. Abhi uncertainty hai is liye market thoda cautious (soch-samajh ke chal rahi hai) hai. Yeh event kal ke baad sab clear kar dega — is liye aaj ka sentiment NEUTRAL (na zyada upar na zyada neeche) component hai WASDE ki wajah se.
